发件人ID叫李拓。

“坐标：灰脊石林暗河支脉废弃矿洞！附近有没有活人！”

“老子是退伍侦察兵！觉醒天赋是【地形记忆】！只要是我走过的地方，就算闭着眼睛也能在脑子里建出三维模型！”

“外面全是石蜥蜴！我被堵在矿洞里了！救我出去，这洞里的铁矿全归你们！”

许默呼吸一滞。

一个活体三维雷达的价值简直无法估量！

更何况，矿洞里有现阶段极度稀缺的铁矿石。

他立刻拔出腰间的匕首，把石斧抛给下方的方芸。

“约三公里外，有头肥羊在求救，准备干活。”

方芸疑惑问到。

“现在过去？至少要一两个小时，还有用吗？”

许默却腹黑道。

“不去看看怎么知道，就算他嘎了，咱们捡个骨牌，能得到他的地图天赋的话，不就起飞了？”

灰白色的喀斯特石林静得让人发毛，只有两人踩在碎石上的轻微摩擦声。

一个小时过去，二人浑身燥热，干渴飞速下降。

就在他们穿过一条逼仄的石缝时，两侧岩壁的阴影中毫无征兆地爆出三团灰影。

浓烈的腥臭味扑面而来。

那是三头体长超过一米、浑身覆盖着灰白岩石般鳞片的变异石蜥蜴。

它们完美的保护色骗过了两人的视线，后肢猛地发力，张开长满倒刺的血盆大口直扑许默面门。

许默眼神瞬间变得冷酷无比。

那把涂满灰绿色黏液苔藓的匕首在指尖翻转。

他不仅没退，反而迎着最前面那只石蜥蜴的利爪悍然撞了上去。

“嘶啦——”

黑色的锋刃精准无比地切入蜥蜴覆盖着厚重鳞片的后腿关节。

黏液苔藓瞬间生效，那头原本快如闪电的畜生像是陷入了泥沼，动作出现了肉眼可见的极度迟缓。

破空声紧随而至。

方芸手中的迷雾之弓早已拉如满月，淬着致命毒液的箭矢化作一道黑芒，精准无误地贯穿了那头石蜥蜴的眼眶，带着一抹污血死死钉在后方的岩壁上。

许默借着冲力一个滑铲，恐怖战斗力全面爆发。

他左手死死扼住第二只蜥蜴的咽喉，右手匕首化作残影，疯狂捅进它的腹部。

第三只刚想掉头逃窜，被方芸第二箭直接钉穿了脊椎。

战斗在短短十秒内结束。

满地狼藉中，五片泛着幽绿色光芒的石蜥蜴鳞片闪烁光芒，紧紧贴在蜥蜴身躯上，系统判定为一阶护甲材料。

The sender ID is Li Tuo.

"Coordinates: Abandoned mine cave in the underground river branch of Gray Ridge Stone Forest! Are there any living people nearby?"

"I'm a retired scout! My awakening talent is [Terrain Memory]! As long as it's a place I've walked through, I can build a three-dimensional model in my mind even with my eyes closed!"

"It's full of stone lizards outside! I'm stuck in a mine! Get me out. The iron ore in this cave belongs to you!"

Xu Mo's breath froze.

The value of a living three-dimensional radar is simply immeasurable!

What's more, the mine contains iron ore, which is currently extremely scarce.

He immediately pulled out the dagger from his waist and threw the stone ax to Fang Yun below.

"About three kilometers away, there is a fat sheep asking for help and getting ready to work."

Fang Yun asked doubtfully.

"Go now? It will take at least an hour or two. Is there any use?"

Xu Mo is evil.

"How do you know if you don't go and take a look? Even if he fails, let's pick up a domino. If we can get his map talent, won't we take off?"

The gray-white karst stone forest was so quiet that it was so quiet that there was only the slight sound of two people stepping on the gravel.

An hour later, both of them were feeling hot and thirsty.

Just as they passed through a narrow stone crevice, three groups of gray shadows burst out from the shadows of the rock walls on both sides without warning.

A strong fishy smell hit my face.

It was a three-headed mutated stone lizard that was over one meter long and covered with gray-white rock-like scales.

Their perfect protective color deceived the two people's sight, and their hind limbs suddenly exerted force, opening their bloody mouth covered with barbs and rushing towards Xu Mo's face.

Xu Mo's eyes instantly became extremely cold.

The dagger covered with gray-green slime moss turned over at his fingertips.

Not only did he not retreat, but he slammed into the sharp claws of the stone lizard at the front.

"Hiss-"

The black blade cut into the lizard's hind leg joints covered with thick scales with incomparable precision.

The slime moss took effect instantly, and the beast that was originally as fast as lightning seemed to be stuck in a quagmire, and its movements were extremely slow visible to the naked eye.

The sound of breaking the air followed closely.

The bow of mist in Fang Yun's hand had already been drawn like a full moon, and the arrow quenched with deadly venom turned into a black light, accurately piercing the eye socket of the stone lizard, and nailed to the rock wall behind with a trace of blood.

Xu Mo used the momentum to make a sliding shovel, and his terrifying combat power exploded.

He grabbed the second lizard's throat with his left hand, and the dagger in his right hand turned into an afterimage, stabbing it crazily into its abdomen.

The third one was about to turn around and run away, but Fang Yun's second arrow pierced its spine.

The battle was over in just ten seconds.

Amid the mess on the ground, five stone lizard scales glowing with a dark green light shone brightly and clung to the lizard's body. The system determined it to be a first-level armor material.
